claims: Bill Ackman has launched a combined IPO for Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS) and Pershing Square Inc. (PSI).
Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS) is a new $5-$10 billion closed-end fund.
Pershing Square Inc. (PSI) is the management firm.
Pershing Square Inc. (PSI) is an asset manager.
The pricing for the combined IPO is set for April 28, 2026.
PSUS shares are priced at $50 each.
Investors receive one PSI share for every five PSUS shares purchased.
PSUS will be listed on the New York Stock Exchange under ticker PSUS.
PSI will be listed on the New York Stock Exchange under ticker PS.
The IPO seeks to raise between $5 billion and $10 billion.
For every 100 PSUS shares purchased in the IPO, investors receive 20 PSI shares at no additional cost.
PSUS aims to invest in 12 to 15 large-cap, undervalued North American companies with strong, durable growth.
The roadshow aimed at providing permanent capital to manage a portfolio similar to Bill Ackman’s existing hedge fund.
The combined offering includes a $2.8 billion private placement.
The final completion is subject to market conditions.
